title: Longest Subarray With Sum Divisible by K
statement_md: Longest Subarray With Sum Divisible by K (medium, hash maps, prefix sums, arrays). See the examples below.

visible_tests.explanation: The first four elements sum to 3.

hidden_generator_py:
import json, random
random.seed(7)
for _ in range(12):
    n = random.randint(1, 40)
    nums = [random.randint(-20, 20) for _ in range(n)]
    k = random.randint(2, 10)
    print(json.dumps({'args': {'nums': nums, 'k': k}}))
